seo.homeFaq5A: Lambun FreeTV wani shiri ne na daban, wanda ke gudanar da kansa - ba shi da alaƙa da radio.garden. Yana ba da mafi sauƙi, mafi sauƙin dubawa tare da kewayawa mai sauƙi, kuma ya wuce rediyo tare da TV kai tsaye da kyamarar gidan yanar gizon da aka gina cikin kayan aikin tap ɗaya kyauta.
seo.homeFaq6Q: Menene ya faru da tsohon shafin Lambun FreeTool TV akan Odoo?
seo.homeFaq6A: An sake buɗe shi anan. Shafin da ya saba zama a freetool.odoo.com/tv-garden aiki iri daya ne, yanzu yana gudana a karkashin sunansa da yankinsa: Lambun FreeTV.
seo.homeFaq7A: Babu asusu da ake bukata. Lambun FreeTV baya neman imel, kalmar sirri, ko kowane bayanan sirri don kallo.
seo.homeFaq8A: Ee - Lambun FreeTV yana gudana a cikin kowane mai binciken wayar hannu na zamani akan Android ko iPhone, kuma ana iya ƙarawa zuwa allon gida don samun dama ta taɓawa ɗaya (duba sashin Shigar da ke sama).
seo.homeFaq9A: Tashoshi rafi ne kai tsaye da aka samo su daga masu watsa shirye-shiryen jama'a, don haka wasu suna yin layi na ɗan lokaci saboda matsalar uwar garke. Gwada wata tashar, ko duba baya daga baya - yawancin suna dawowa cikin 'yan mintuna zuwa sa'o'i.
seo.homeFaq10Q: Shin rafukan sun halatta a kalla?
seo.homeFaq10A: Lambun FreeTV yana tattara rafukan raye-raye na jama'a - da farko daga littafin al'umma na iptv-org - kuma baya ɗaukar nauyin ko adana kowane fayilolin bidiyo da kansa. Duba sashin Shari'a & Tsaro a ƙasa don ƙarin.

seo.homeLegal: Lambun FreeTV yana tattara rafukan raye-raye na jama'a daga kyauta, kafofin jama'a, gami da kundin adireshin al'umma na iptv-org. Ba ya ɗaukar nauyin ko adana kowane bidiyo ko fayilolin mai jiwuwa, kuma baya buƙatar asusu don amfani da shi.
